description: The manifest used to describe datasets for the Synapse Data Catalog.

AgeGroup.description: Age group of the individual(s)/subject(s) the dataset's data were generated from (e.g. Adult). Free text pending a confident controlled vocabulary - too few real values observed to seed one yet.
AgeGroup.title: ageGroup

AlternateName.description: An altername name that can be used for search and discovery improvement.
AlternateName.title: alternateName

Attribution.description: The attribution statement for the data associated with the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus7.
Attribution.title: attribution

Authors.description: Author list for the dataset's associated publication. Distinct from creator, which captures the person(s)/organization(s) that generated or deposited the data itself.
Authors.title: authors

Citation.description: Academic articles that are recommended by the data provider to be cited in addition to the dataset doi itself. Can be identical to DatasetView.PublicationView Key.
Citation.title: citation

CollaborationRequired.description: If collaboration is required for the access requirement, provide the PI email address. Provide multiple as a comma-separated list.
CollaborationRequired.title: collaborationRequired

Community.description: The Sage Bionetworks project or initiative with which the dataset is associated.
Community.title: community

ConditionsOfAccess.description: Additional requirements a user may need outside of Data Use Modifiers. This could include additional registration, updating profile information, joining a Synapse Team, or using specific authentication methods like 2FA or RAS. Omit property if not applicable/unknown.
ConditionsOfAccess.title: conditionsOfAccess

CountryOfOrigin.description: Origin of individuals from which data were generated. Omit if not applicable/unknown.
CountryOfOrigin.title: countryOfOrigin

Creator.description: Organization or person that is creator of the dataset. Default is the PI of the project and/or the user who created all files in the dataset.
Creator.title: creator

CroissantS3FileObject.description: A Synapse url where the croissant file associated with this dataset is stored.
CroissantS3FileObject.title: croissant_s3_file_object

DataCatalogDataUseModifiers.description: List of data use ontology (DUO) terms that are true for dataset, which describes the allowable scope and terms for data use. Omit property if not applicable/unknown.
DataCatalogDataUseModifiers.title: dataCatalogDataUseModifiers

DataCatalogId.description: Unique ID associated with a Data Catalog entry, used as a key for record linking and updates.
DataCatalogId.title: DataCatalog_id

DataCatalogLicense.description: The terms and conditions underwhich the data are allowed to be accessed and used. Unless information for license is clear, this should default to UNKNOWN.
DataCatalogLicense.title: dataCatalogLicense

DataPermission.description: The permissions associated with the data under the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus4.
DataPermission.title: dataPermission

DataTier.description: The tier of data access associated with the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus5.
DataTier.title: dataTier

DataType.description: Broad data-type category for the dataset (e.g. gene expression, chromatin activity, genomic variants). Aligned with modules/shared/mc2_iconTag_map_3-4-25.csv's label taxonomy.
DataType.title: dataType

DatasetViewKey.description: Unique DatasetView_id foreign key(s) that link metadata entries as part of the same collection. Please provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
DatasetViewKey.title: DatasetView Key

DatePublished.description: Date data were published/available on Synapse.
DatePublished.title: datePublished

DeidentificationType.description: The type of de-identification applied to the data associated with the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus3.
DeidentificationType.title: deidentificationType

Description.description: A text description of the dataset. Can be identifical to Dataset Description.
Description.title: description

DiseaseFocus.description: Disease area the dataset focuses on, as annotated directly on the Synapse Dataset entity. Not populated in current practice.
DiseaseFocus.title: diseaseFocus

DiseaseSpecificResearch.description: The type(s) of disease research allowed by this access requirement. Provide the MONDO ID in format MONDO:id. Provide multiple values as a comma-separated list. MONDO terms can be found here: https://ols.monarchinitiative.org/ontologies/mondo
DiseaseSpecificResearch.title: diseaseSpecificResearch

Doi.description: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for citation and identification. Can be identical to Dataset Doi
Doi.title: doi

DownloadType.description: Hosting type for the dataset's files, as annotated directly on the Synapse Dataset entity (distinct from the CCKP portal's own DatasetView.downloadType column).
DownloadType.title: downloadType

ExternalRepositoryUri.description: External repository identifier(s) for the dataset, as CURIE-shaped references (e.g. geo:GSE12345, sra:SRP12345, bioproject:PRJNA12345).
ExternalRepositoryUri.title: externalRepositoryUri

Funder.description: The entity(ies) responsible for funding the data contributors.
Funder.title: funder

GeographicalRestriction.description: The specific geographic region(s) to which use is limited by the access requirement.
GeographicalRestriction.title: geographicalRestriction

GrantViewKey.description: Unique GrantView_id foreign key(s) that group the resource with other components, as part of the same grant-associated collection. Please provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
GrantViewKey.title: GrantView Key

IncludedInDataCatalog.description: Link(s) to known data catalog(s) the dataset is included in.
IncludedInDataCatalog.title: includedInDataCatalog

IndividualCount.description: The number of participants or samples associated with the files in the dataset. Can be identical to Study Number of Participants or DSP Number of Participants
IndividualCount.title: individualCount

InstitutionSpecificRestriction.description: Institutions with specific restrictions associated with the access requirement. Provide the institution ROR ID in format ROR:id. Provide multiple entries as a comma-separated list. ROR IDs can be found here: https://ror.org/search
InstitutionSpecificRestriction.title: institutionSpecificRestriction

Keywords.description: Keywords associated with the dataset. Can be identical to Publication Keywords.
Keywords.title: keywords

License.description: The license under which the data associated with the access requirement is shared. Equivalent to DUOPlus6.
License.title: license

Link.description: The url where the dataset is displayed, typically on a public-facing data portal. Can be identical to Dataset Url.
Link.title: link

Manifestation.description: Tumor type or other clinical manifestation associated with the dataset. Can be identical to Dataset Tumor Type.
Manifestation.title: manifestation

MeasurementTechnique.description: Assay used to generate original data. Omit if not applicable (e.g. for curated dataset such as a list compounds from a database or text extracted from Wikipedia). Can be identical to Dataset Assay.
MeasurementTechnique.title: measurementTechnique

PopulationType.description: The population studied in the research associated with the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus2
PopulationType.title: populationType

Portal.description: The Sage Bionetworks portal that curated this record (e.g. CCKP). Distinguishes provenance if this vocabulary is ever shared across multiple Sage portals.
Portal.title: portal

PublicationMoratorium.description: End date of the publication moratorium associated with the access requirement.
PublicationMoratorium.title: publicationMoratorium

ResearchSpecificRestrictions.description: Research-specific restrictions associated with the access requirement.
ResearchSpecificRestrictions.title: researchSpecificRestrictions

Series.description: Data series designation (e.g., NF-OSI Processed Data).
Series.title: series

SourceGeography.description: The geographical source of the data associated with the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus1.
SourceGeography.title: sourceGeography

Species.description: Species of the organism(s) from which the data were generated. Omit property if not applicable, such as for data like compounds or other non-biological data. Can be identical to Dataset Species.
Species.title: species

SpecimenCount.description: Number of unique specimens in the dataset. Can be identical to DSP Number of Samples.
SpecimenCount.title: specimenCount

StudyId.description: Unique row identifier, used as a primary key for record updates.
StudyId.title: Study_id

StudyKey.description: The unique Study_id foreign keys associated with the resource, found in the grant Study information. Used to group the resource with other components. Please provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
StudyKey.title: Study Key

Subject.description: Applicable subject term(s) for dataset cataloging - in practice, a free-text model-system/specimen descriptor (e.g. C57BL/6, NOD SCID), not a Library of Congress Subject Heading.
Subject.title: subject

TimeLimitOnUse.description: Time limit on the use of the data associated with the access requirement.
TimeLimitOnUse.title: timeLimitOnUse

UserSpecificRestriction.description: The user-specific restrictions associated with the access requirement.
UserSpecificRestriction.title: userSpecificRestriction

YearProcessed.description: Year the data were processed (used with specific series only).
YearProcessed.title: yearProcessed

title: DataCatalog
